$comment: EVALUATOR SEPARATION. A candidate branch (prefix listed below) may change the PRODUCT, never the things that JUDGE the product, in the same change. Otherwise the loop learns that weakening a test is cheaper than improving the page. That includes the MEASUREMENT PATH: who is assigned to which arm, what counts as an exposure or a conversion, and the sink those events land in — a candidate that can edit those can change what gets judged, not just how. Changing an evaluator is a different class of authority: a normal branch, reviewed on its own. Checked by scripts/agent-os/check-evaluator-separation.mjs; canaried by evaluatorSeparation.test.mjs.
